entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane divided into five shards, each built around three types of mana.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara flush with the magic of honor, growth, and manipulation.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara that flows with blue mana and its allies, with rigid social rules and a mania for eradicating imperfection.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara that is a world of death, once connected to the other shards.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A shard of Alara where almost every living thing is both predator and prey, with dragons at the top of the food chain.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara dominated by gargantuans, ancient behemoths worshipped by humans and elves.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who dares hunt dragons on Jund and holds a fierce reverence for them.

entities.name: Cinna
entities.description: A vedalken consul of Esper and a great speaker.

events.summary: The column notes that Grixis was once connected to the other shards and flush with life, before becoming a world of death.
events.quote: Grixis is a world of death—but at one time, when Alara was young, it was still connected to the other shards, and still flush with life.

relations.note: Described as a vedalken consul giving an Esper outlook.
relations.quote: The vedalken consul Cinna, a great speaker wherever she goes, gives us a particularly Esperesque outlook on how to go about building theories

relations.note: An elf prophetess whose quote concerns Naya's behemoths.
relations.quote: This piece of flavor text, using the elf prophetess Mayael as the mouthpiece
